desc:
• BREAKFAST OF CHAMPIONS: Wheaties Cereal made from toasted 100% whole wheat flakes is the original Breakfast of Champions; An ideal ready to eat pantry staple that the whole family can enjoy

  • COLLECTIBLE BOX: Wheaties has been synonymous with greatness, featuring some of the most decorated athletes in history on the iconic orange collectible box; Add some flakes to cereal bars or trail mix recipes as delicious snacks for adults or kids

  • MADE WITH WHOLE GRAIN: 32g whole grain per serving (at least 48 grams recommended daily); Enjoy a bowl of cereal with milk for a great start to your day

  • WHOLESOME BREAKFAST ADDITION: Each serving is a good source of fiber (4g fiber and .5g fat per serving) and provides B vitamins to help unlock energy; Also makes a tasty snack

  • CONTAINS: One cardboard box of crunchy Wheaties Breakfast Cereal, Breakfast of Champions, 100% Whole Wheat Flakes, 15.6 oz; Perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals
features:
Features

100% Whole Grain Wheat Flakes
Made entirely from whole grain wheat for a hearty, wholesome breakfast.

Lightly Toasted Crunch
Crisp texture with a subtle toasty flavor that holds up in milk.

Simple, Clean Ingredients
No artificial colors or flavors, with a straightforward ingredient list.

Fortified with Nutrients
Enriched with vitamins and minerals like iron, folate, B-vitamins, and others.

Kosher Certified
Suitable for various dietary needs and preferences.

Family-Size Box
Generous portion ideal for households, meal prep, or long-term pantry storage.

Benefits

Supports Heart and Digestive Health
High in whole grains and fiber, which promote digestive well-being and help maintain healthy cholesterol levels.

Versatile Breakfast Staple
Enjoy it in milk, with yogurt, mixed into smoothie bowls, or as a base for homemade granola mixes.

Kid-Friendly and Adult Approved
Simple and mild taste makes it a breakfast favorite for all ages.

Nutritious Start to Your Day
Fortified with essential vitamins and minerals to help reach daily nutritional goals.

Quick and Convenient
Ready to serve in seconds—no cooking or preparation required.

Great Value for Families
Large box offers multiple servings, making it a cost-effective daily choice.

Consistent Quality
A trusted cereal brand known for delivering crisp flakes and dependable flavor.
ingredients: Whole Grain Wheat, Sugar, Honey, Salt. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
